text: Nergeld is used in The Sum is Greater than the Parts to kill Dr. Terrible. It is an amalgamation of Vargul corpses and is described as the "ultimate creation" by Dr. Terrible, who plans to make an army of these stitched corpses. But the player takes control over Nergeld and destroys Dr. Terrible before his plan comes into fruition.

Nerubian Archaeology Fragments are found using the Survey ability of the Archaeology skill. As with all Archaeology Fragments, they are not inventory items but instead tracked on the relevant page of a player's archaeology dialog. These fragments are found at Nerubian archaeology sites.
Neophyte Starcrest is a night elf quest giver at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains. She can be found speaking with Arcanist Valdurian outside the inn.
Nether Plating is a passive Demonology warlock ability, available at level 27.

Nephew Bentnail is a grummle found at One Keg in Kun-Lai Summit. He travels with the adventurer to Neverest Basecamp on Ji-Lu's Cart, which is his first trip to the mountain. According to Lucky Bluestring, Bentnail's appetite is like a yeti's.
Nether Blast is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Neophyte Nemarn is a draenei located at the Aldor Rise in Shattrath City.
Nessos the Oracle is a rare saurok found outside an island hut off the northern coast of Kun-Lai Summit. Nessos the Oracle is a pandarian champion.
Nether Gate is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Nest Guardians are powerful pandaren phoenixes, similar in look to Ji-Kun, that protect certain nests during heroic mode only. If left alone they will do an aoe attack that hurts all raid members and interrupts all spell casts.
Nessa's Collection is provided as an objective for Flight to Auberdine and The Bounty of Teldrassil.

Netherbeak is a large purple-violet hippogryph found flying high in west central Azsuna, west of Azurewing Repose. Only hunters who have the secrets of taming Feathermanes can coax it down from stealth mode. He, however, is very aggressive.
__NOTOC__ Nerus' Journal is looted from the Moonfang Chest in Andu'talah in Val'sharah.

__NOTOC__ Nethaera's Light is a magical candle found in Dalaran in Northrend. Doing a /cheer at it, will make it brighten its light and give the adventurer a non-combat companion, added to the Pet Journal. In Battle for Azeroth this NPC was added to Dazar'alor next to Zununu the Undefeated.

Nerub'ar Corpse Harvesters are nerubian flyers located in the Borean Tundra. They are invading Warsong Hold through the quarry within the stronghold. Unwilling to let them take down Warsong Hold's defenses Overlord Razgor sends Horde forces in going on the offensive against them.

Nerub'ar Sky Darkeners are nerubian flyers located in the Borean Tundra. They are invading Warsong Hold through the quarry within the stronghold. Unwilling to let them take down Warsong Hold's defenses Overlord Razgor sends Horde forces in going on the offensive against them. They spawn in massive waves to prelude the coming of Ith'rix the Harvester.
__NOTOC__ Nestmother Acada is a vulture found flying around Shepherd's Bluff in Stormsong Valley with two Brinebeak Albatrosses. She is summoned by interacting with her nest in the Jeweled Coast.
Nerubian Cocoons are cocoons located in Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak. Destroying them will spawn Captive Footmen and Drakkari Captives.
Nethercaller Cloak drops from Lord Commander Alexius and Fel Commander Erixtol in Highmountain.
Netherfiend Armbands drop from Lord Commander Alexius and Fel Commander Erixtol in Highmountain.
Netherfiend Trousers drop from Lord Commander Alexius and Fel Commander Erixtol in Highmountain.
Nesingwary's Trapping Apparatus is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of a Trapping Apparatus.
__NOTOC__ Nether-Gorged Greatwyrm is a mana wyrm flying mount.
Nether Energy is one of the pet abilities that only Rays can use.
*Nesingwary's Expedition, a camp in Stranglethorn Vale. *Hemet Nesingwary, a famous explorer in Warcraft universe. *Hemet Nesingwary Jr., son of Hemet Nesingwary. *Server:Nesingwary US

Netherstone is a region of crystalline spires located in northern Netherstorm between Eco-Dome Farfield and the Ruins of Farahlon. It is densely populated by powerful and well-camoflauged Farahlon colossi. The giants are an excellent, albeit dangerous, source of the rare crystal known as "farahlite". The crystal can be found as Raw Farahlite, which the ethereals of Stormspire are very interested in obtaining for economic purposes.

The Netherwing Fields are a section of crystal-studded plains in southeastern Shadowmoon Valley, just southwest of the Black Temple. The fields are home to many nether drakes and even some nether dragons.

__NOTOC__ Nethrandamus is Altruis the Sufferer's nether drake mount. Players fly on Nethrandamus during the quest Survey the Land, where he takes players on a tour of the Forge Camps of Nagrand. While Altruis appears in Legion, Nethrandamus does not. However, Nethrandamus' Zephyr is a reward from Dark Revelations.
Nethervine Crystals can be found on Netherwing Ledge in Shadowmoon Valley.

Netherwing Eggs has a chance of dropping from all creatures and item nodes on the Netherwing Ledge, in the Netherwing Mines or at the Dragonmaw Fortress of Shadowmoon Valley with a very low drop rate of 1% or less. They can also be found on the ground tucked under crystal clusters, in mining carts, through mining Nethercite Deposit, and gathering herbs from Netherdust Bush. Their location is easily displayed by the tall pillar of violet smoke given off by the eggs, making their presence known from underneath rail tracks and over hills. Naturally, other players can see this as well, and competition for these can be fierce. The Netherwing Egg respawns every hour, respawning in different places
Netherwing Relic drops from Dragonmaw Transporters in Dragonmaw Skyway in Shadowmoon Valley.
Netherwing Crystal drops from most, if not all, creatures on the Netherwing Ledge and in the Netherwing Mines of Shadowmoon Valley.
Nethermine Cargo can be found in the Netherwing Mines of Shadowmoon Valley.
Use the Netherweave Net to capture a target! The magical net can be made with Tailoring.

Netherskates are nether rays found in Shadowmoon Valley. They have a unique red skin. Like the Netherwing Ray, they have no mana of their own, but will steal it from foes, and if they drain enough will cast Nether Shock.
Netherwing Rays are nether rays found at the Netherwing Ledge in Shadowmoon Valley.
__NOTOC__ Nethermine Flayers are rock flayers located in the Netherwing Mines in Shadowmoon Valley.
__NOTOC__ Nethestrasz is the flight master located at Wyrmrest Temple in the contested territory of Dragonblight. In the Dragon Soul raid, he transports players to the top of the temple.
Netherweb Victim is an unknown victim trapped within the spider's webs of Netherweb Ridge in Terokkar Forest. They will contain a random mob or npc will destroyed.

The New Avalon Orchard is located in south-central New Avalon, just north of the Scarlet Tavern and the Chapel of the Crimson Flame, between the New Avalon Town Hall to the west and the Scarlet Overlook to the east, southwest of the Scarlet Hold. The orchard are destroyed during the Scourge assault.

The Nethervine is a sect of satyrs helping the Sunfury in the Botanica, within Tempest Keep. Their leader Thorngrin the Tender, works to make sure that Kael'thas's botanists have the power and essence they need to reveal the naaru's secrets, even if that means untold numbers of living creatures must be sacrificed to obtain it. The Nethervine would come under attack from adventurers from Azeroth, at the behest of the Sha'tar and A'dal, who sought the death of Thorngrin the Tender. With many of them slain, including their leader, it is unknown if the Nethervine still exist as a group.

The Nethermine flayers are a pack of rock flayers settled within the Netherwing Mines on Netherwing Ledge in Shadowmoon Valley. This pack of flayers was riled up by the waking of a dragon and are becoming a thorn in the Dragonmaw fel orcs' sides. They seem to get along with the Nethermine Ravagers.

The neutralizer grenade is an experimental attempt to create a device that will interfere with the workingw of other devices. Thrown in to an area, it explodes to release a jolt of electricity to melt wiring, dues and oil to clog delicate gearwork, and a cloud of inert phlogiston gas to interfere with phlogiston boilers.
Nethermancy is a passive warlock ability learned at level 50.

Neverest Pinnacle is the highest point on all of Pandaria, found atop Mount Neverest in Kun-Lai Summit. The pinnacle can be reached via One Keg. Follow the mountain pass to the northewest up to Neverest Basecamp, then follow Seeker's Folly to Seeker's Point, and continuing the trail uphill. In the shadow of the pinnacle itself is a statue of Ren Yun the Blind.
Nethermine Ravagers are ravagers found in the Netherwing Mines in Shadowmoon Valley.
Nevermore is an ability used by Gilnean Raven during a Pet Battle.

Netherwinds was a pet ability unique to Nether Rays. It was identical to the bloodlust effects used by other classes; a raid would usually request a hunter employ a Nether Ray pet if it did not already have a class that could produce the effect. Unlike core hounds, Nether Rays are not exotic and could be used by a hunter of any specialization.

The New Hearthglen abbey is an unnamed location in the Scarlet Onslaught city of New Hearthglen. The abbey is built very much like Northshire Abbey, comprised of three sections named the Main Hall, the Hall of Arms, and the Library Wing. In the bell tower is the Abbey Bell Rope, which is an objective for the quest A Fall From Grace and summons the Devout Bodyguards away, so that the player can speak with High Abbot Landgren.
Newly Crafted Infernals can be found in the Deathforge in Shadowmoon Valley.
Netherwind Wands were sold for by Arcanist Tero'shan during Island Expeditions.

The Nethergarde caravan is a group of Stormwind footmen supplying Nethergarde Keep. The supply line is tenuous and the caravans are often attacked in the Swamp of Sorrows. They transport rare supplies and reagents such as power stones and Azoran Crystals.
The Neural Accelerator drops from the HK-3 Aerial Dissuasion Unit on Mechagon Island.
__NOTOC__ Neutronium Surges are water elementals located on Mechagon Island.
Netherlord's Cypher is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Netherlord's Gift is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Netherlord's Invocation is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Netherlord's Legacy is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Netherlord's Lesson is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Netherlord's Mythos is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Netherlord's Ultimatum is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Neural Pet Enhancer is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Newly Forged Horn is crafted by Master Smith Helgar in Skyhold during the Chains of Domination campaign. With Odyn's power, and that of several chosen Val'kyr, it gains the name Ilskahorn.
Neural Autonomy can be purchased from Stolen Royal Vendorbot in Rustbolt of Mechagon Island for after reaching with the Rustbolt Resistance.

The Night Elf Runner was sent out by Maiev Shadowsong to get help from Malfurion Stormrage in the night elf campaign Terror of the Tides mission "Wrath of the Betrayer." She has no attack, but she has a healing ability.
Nida Winterhoof is a tauren herbalism vendor located on the middle rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, she was trapped by the Void.

Nexus-Prince Haramad is the leader of the Consortium and can be seen as a hologram in the upper Stormspire, Netherstorm, and outside the Mana-Tombs of Auchindoun. As he says himself when spoken to, Nexus-Prince Haramad has so many enemies that would like to see him dead, that it is simpler that he be represented by a harmless apparition of himself. He is one of three nexus-princes found in Outland (the others being Nexus-Prince Razaan in Blade's Edge Mountains, and Nexus-Prince Shaffar inside the Mana-Tombs). With Mists of Pandaria, Haramad has expanded his business to the Black Market Auction House.
Nida is a human child found in Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. Nida lost the necklace her father gave her, and her friend Shawn would like it retrieved.
__NOTOC__ .]] The Nexus Torch drops from Warchief Kargath Bladefist in the Shattered Halls.

This is a long quest line that can be done in Karazhan to acquire Medivh's Journal and summon the final boss: Nightbane. The point of the quest line is to supply the Violet Eye with more insight on Medivh's powers. You must be honored with the Violet Eye to accept this quest.
Nexus-Stalker's band is an ring. It gives bonuses to strength, agility, and stamina.

Repeatable quest to turn in a Mark of the Nexus-King for a Shaffar's Stasis Chamber Key. You need the Stasis Chamber Key to summon Yor in Mana-Tombs. This key is a one-use item, meaning you will need to farm up a Mark each time you wish to summon Yor. Once you are Exalted with the Consortium you can obtain The Eye of Haramad which is a permanent item. The Mark of the Nexus-King drop from mobs summoned from Ethereum Stasis Chambers in Blade's Edge Mountains.

Night Elf Corpses are night elves found around the Night Elf Moon Crystal in An'telas in the Ghostlands. They were members of the Sentinel spies and died defending their camp from blood elf ambushers.
The Night Elf Moon Crystals are located in An'daroth, An'telas, and An'owyn of Ghostlands.
__NOTOC__ Nexus Lords are human, blood elf, and high elf mages aligned with the Blue dragonflight found in the Eye of Eternity. They are a part of phase 2 of the Malygos encounter.
Nexus Point is an original English manga written by Richard Knaak and illustrated by Kim Jae-Hwan taking place in the Warcraft universe. It is Volume 2 in Shadow Wing.
The Nexus Guardian is a sole blue dragon who flies above the Moonrest Gardens in Dragonblight occasionally coming down to hover just over the night elf tower ruin by the shore.
Nexus Watchers are blue dragons that patrol the skies over the Nexus on the island of Coldarra in the Borean Tundra.

Nexus Drake Hatchlings are blue drakes found flying in the northwestern region of Coldarra in the Borean Tundra. Raelorasz asks players to subdue one of these drakes for him to study in the quest Drake Hunt and the subsequent daily by the same name (Drake Hunt (daily)).

Night Elf Archaeology Fragments are found using the Survey ability of the Archaeology skill. As with all Archaeology Fragments, they are not inventory items but instead tracked on the relevant page of a player's archaeology dialog. These fragments are found at Night Elf archaeology sites.

Nezir is a mighty djinn that commands the winds of the North. Nezir and the rest of the Conclave survived their defeat in the Throne of the Four Winds. They initially supported Prince Sarsarun to succeed Al'Akir, but were ultimately convinced of Thunderaan's power.

The night elf starting experience takes place in Shadowglen on Teldrassil, continuing afterwards to Dolanaar. In it, players help the elves of Shadowglen as they fight against the lingering corruption on Teldrassil. Together with Priestess Dentaria Silverglade, players seek out the guardian of the forest Tarindrella and help her cleanse the corrupted spiders from the land. Finally players travel onward to Dolanaar and the rest of Teldrassil. #The Balance of Nature #Fel Moss Corruption & Demonic Thieves #*A Favor for Melithar (optional in-between breadcrumb) #Priestess of the Moon (quest) #Iverron's Antidote #The Woodland Protector #Webwood Corruption #Vile Touch #Signs of Things to Come #Tel

Nexus-Lord Donjon Rade is an NPC added as part of the Warlords of Draenor beta, serving to teleport players to the dungeons and raids currently available for testing. He can be found in capital cities, player garrisons and other zone-in areas.
Nhallish is a void revenant and the second boss encounter in the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds dungeon.

The Night Elf Village is located in the Hyjal Summit area during the Battle for Mount Hyjal. It is traveled to after the Horde Encampment falls. Here, Tyrande Whisperwind gives the Tears of the Goddess for use against Archimonde. The village is the one military base of the battle that doesn't look much like it was in Warcraft III. It is protected by several ancient protectors, an ancient of war, and an ancient of lore. There also several moonwells, a Hunter's Hall, and a few kaldorei towers. The base is populated with archers, huntresses, druids of the claw, druids of the talon and dryads. Several glaive throwers can also be seen even though they were not used by the Sentinels during Warcraf
__NOTOC__ Niaa is a draenei flight master located at Exarch's Refuge in Talador.

Nexus-Lord Donjon Rade Sr. is an NPC added as part of the Legion alpha, serving to teleport players to the dungeons and raids currently available for testing. He can be found in capital cities. He also appeared during the Battle for Azeroth alpha.
__NOTOC__ Night Elf Mages are night elves located in the Battlescar Valley of the Stonetalon Mountains. Some of them are targeted and killed by Horde adventurers.

Nexus-Lord Donjon Rade III is an NPC added as part of the Battle for Azeroth alpha, serving to teleport players to the dungeons and raids currently available for testing. He can be found in capital cities.
The Night Elf Ring drops from Toxic Lurkers on Mechagon Island.
Nico Patchbutton is a Mechagon mechagnome located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island. He is working on a Mechanized Enforcer and Prototype Sentry.

__NOTOC__ Nexus-Lord Donjon Rade IV is an ethereal added as part of the World of Warcraft: Shadowlands beta, serving to teleport players to the dungeons and raids currently available for testing. He can be found in capital cities.
Night Elf Wisp Specimens are wisps located outside the Hyjal Summit in the Caverns of Time. They have been frozen in time by the bronze dragonflight.

Night Elf Souls are the souls of night elves that were killed during the burning of Teldrassil. Claimed by the Maw, they were all imprisoned in Torghast, only to be rescued by the Maw Walker, who used the Soulkeeper Crystal to absorb them and have them transported to Ardenweald. A group of them were absorbed to create a Tortured Amalgamation, only for it to be defeated by Tyrande Whisperwind, Shandris Feathermoon, and the Maw Walker, who managed to use the crystal to absorb the souls in order to weaken the shade. After being transported out of the Maw, they are now located at the Hibernal Hollow. They also appear in the Ring of Fates in Oribos during Prisoner of Interest.

The Night Fae Assault is one of four bi-weekly covenant assaults on the Maw in patch 9.1. This assault focuses on the Crucible of the Damned. At camp are: Lord Herne, Margrave Sin'dane, Thiernax, Dreamweaver, Lady Moonberry, Niya, Bonesmith Heirmir, Choofa, Krrprripripkraak, Rathan, and Emeni. Others taking part include Droman Aliothe and Droman Tashmur. Night Fae Covenant players with at least rank 1 of the transport network will find a Mushroom to the Maw in the Ring. There's a Mushroom to the Ring at the Night Fae camp in the Maw that will send players back. If A Shady Place is one of the active quests, players will be able to access The Rift, an alternate plane of existence in the Maw, f
Nexus-Lord Donjon Rade Jr. is an ethereal found in major cities. He provides teleportation to raids undergoing testing.
Nibble is a pet battle ability used primarily by critter companions.
Nightborne Armaments are looted from Nightborne Arms Caches in Suramar City. Using the item will summon a Crate of Weapons.

Nightfin Soup is an exceptional bit of food for healers. Nightfin Soup is generally most valuable during long boss encounters that are mana intensive. Combined with other items such as a Mageblood Potion and Brilliant Mana Oil, a caster even in mediocre gear can have very good mana regeneration.
The Nightfall Drape is a Level 50 quality Cloak that improves Strength, Stamina and Dodge.

Nightwind is a jungle troll holy strider. This troll has a shock of black hair shooting from the top of her head, swept back as though the wind is always in her face. Always grinning, she puts most people at ease when she first meets them; but her sharp mind takes in all details, and she is usually gone before anyone notices her pilfering through documents or questioning a simple-minded son of a powerful lord. "The nice troll-lady" is loved no matter where she goes, which makes her one of the best spies in Orgrimmar, although she travels under the title of messenger.
Nightmare Spawns are fleshbeasts found in the Earthshatter Cavern in Darkshore after entering the nightmare portal.
The Nightmare Guardian is a fleshbeast found in the Earthshatter Cavern in Darkshore after entering the nightmare portal.
The nightfallen are outcast nightborne elves that have been cut off from the nourishment of the Nightwell due to being exiled from Suramar City and have begun to wither into a state of withdrawal.
.]] Nightmare dragons are members of the green dragonflight corrupted by the Emerald Nightmare. Some of them were encountered in Val'sharah.
Nihilam, the Doom World, is a planet in the Great Dark Beyond where Sargeras and his Burning Legion killed the members of the titan Pantheon at the start of the Burning Crusade.
Nightborne Couriers are nightborne found in the city of Suramar.
Nightwatcher's Perch is a warden tower on the western side of Highmountain.

Nighthuntress Syrenne is a nightborne huntress patrolling in Suramar. When attacked by class leaders she teleports away upon defeat. However, in Patch 7.2.0, her additude towards them changed: The Huntmaster of the Unseen Path encounters her and D'Bynn after healing the latter to full health, where Syrenne enlists the hero's help on solving some clues involving a band of poachers in the Crimson Thicket. After their leader is defeated, Syrenne and D'Bynn both join the ranks of the Unseen Path.
The Nightspire is the main building of the Nighthold. It consists of the interiors of the first two floors of the tower, connected via teleporters. Elisande is fought on the second floor.
__NOTOC__ Nights with the Nightborne is looted from Flight Master's Lost and Found on the Broken Shore.
__NOTOC__ Nightborne Wretches are nightborne located in Suramar City.
Nightborne Sages are nightborne located in Suramar City and in the Nighthold.
The Nightborne Manasaber is a reward from The Nightborne. While very similar in design to Arcanist's Manasaber, unlike the former, this mount is not a flying mount.

__NOTOC__ Nighthold Retainers are nightborne located in the Nighthold of Suramar City in Suramar following its liberation from the Burning Legion. One watches over Theryn. Another one is seen leaving from a Nighthold building. They go behind Sylverin's barrels, look at a map and return inside.
Nighthold Citizens are nightborne located in the Nighthold of Suramar City and inside its instance.

__NOTOC__ Nightborne Trainees are nightborne located in the Nighthold of Suramar City in Suramar after its liberation from the Burning Legion. They are being trained in monk ways by Ji-Sun and Young Su.
Nightguard Arcanists (or Nightwatch Arcanists) are nightborne located in Suramar City.
Nighthaven Defenders are night elf and tauren located in Nighthaven in Moonglade.
Nightvale Sandals is a quest reward from Spread Your Lunarwings and Fly.
Nightvale Leggings is a quest reward from Spread Your Lunarwings and Fly.
Nightmarish Chain Shackles drop from the Hivemind in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.

The Nightborne Vat is located in the Twilight Vineyards in Suramar City during the vulpera recruitment questline. Initially, Kazit is seen stomping fruit in the vat on behalf of Boss Mida. After adventurers reassign the vineyard workers to new roles, Micah Broadhoof becomes responsible for the fruit-stomping, even after Nomi sets the vat on fire.
The Nightborne Teleporters lead to and from Nyell's Workshop in Suramar.
Nightmare Antigens are fleshbeasts located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Nightfeather is a wildkin located in Verdant Wilds during Island Expeditions.
Nightmare Tendrils is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Nightrot is located in the Field of Ferocity in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Nightscale Hatchlings are wind serpents located in Island Expeditions.
Nightscale Screechers are wind serpents located in Island Expeditions.
Nightscale Wind Serpents are wind serpents located in Island Expeditions.
Nightscale Coilfangs are wind serpents located in Island Expeditions.

Nilith Lokrav is a human quest giver located in a small camp northeast of the entrance to Blackrock Mountain in the Searing Gorge. Nilith was located at . Her infernal, Raze, would assist adventurers on one of her quests. Nilith and her camp mates appear to have disappeared following the Cataclysm, and her camp is now populated by Dark Iron dwarves, whose sights are set upon the Iron Summit.
Noarm is a squirrel found in SI:7, Stormwind City, and is a colleague of Doc Mixilpixil.
Nimble-Foot Treads drop from Blood Guard Porung in the Shattered Halls wing in Hellfire Citadel.
Nizzle was a goblin gryphon flight master located in the Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.
Noble's Elementium Signet is sold by Haris Pilton in Shattrath City and by Qixdi Goodstitch in Booty Bay.

:"The tide has begun to turn. The Prophet has led us here to join your valiant fight. By the Light, we must prevail." Nimaasus the Implacable is a draenei paladin. He was adept at Jewelcrafting. Quotes from him and references to him can be found on the following cards: *"A hammer, a libram, and the strength of the Light - all necessary, but the hammer is the most fun." - Hammer of the Righteous
Nobles Deck is an item that begins the quest Darkmoon Nobles Deck, which rewards the player with a .

Noblegarden Eggs can be purchased for from Noblegarden Merchants and Noblegarden Vendors during Noblegarden. Once you place an egg, you cannot place another for one hour. At least one egg is required for the achievement Noble Garden (achievement), which requires the 'hiding' of one egg in Stormwind or Silvermoon.

"Ninja AFK" refers to someone going AFK during a party or a raid without telling anyone, or the raid was otherwise unaware that the member was leaving. This is different than a disconnect (or DC) because the member may not have had the ability to communicate.

The nobles of Darkshire were the ruling class of the township of Darkshire in the Duskwood. Around the beginning of the First War, they were invited at a party overseen by Moroes in Karazhan, where they waited to see Medivh returning from Stormwind City. They died when Medivh, driven insane by the demon within, drained the life of all humans nearby in order to battle Aegwynn. Nowadays they are all ghosts continuing the party like before and assisting Moroes if he fights unannounced visitors. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, the nobles were encountered again in Karazhan, and some of them were freed to join the class orders to fight on the Broken Isles.
Njorndar Proto-Drakes are proto-drakes found in Njorndar Village of Jotunheim in Icecrown. Empowered versions appeared during Death Rising.
__NOTOC__ Nix is a rare firefly found in The Loch at Loch Modan.
Nik the Mountain is a goblin located in Fuselight-by-the-Sea in the Badlands. He wields the legendary sword Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker, which Jafix the Warden is not fond of.

:"Fear seeks to diminish you. :Instead, let it reveal you." Niuzao the Black Ox is one of the four creatures known as the August Celestials who watch over Pandaria. Niuzao watches over the Townlong Steppes and Dread Wastes and is sometimes referred to as the Western Celestial. He is the spirit of fortitude. He has been referred to as the strength of the west and protector of the weak. As such, he is served by the Niuzao sentinels.
Niuzao's Charge is an ability used by Zao, Calfling of Niuzao during a Pet Battle.
No Egg Left Behind is an achievement earned for destroying all remaining eggs before Broodmaster Noshi reaches 20% health in the Dagger in the Dark scenario.
Nimbus is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

No Ticket is an achievement earned from ejecting 20 mobs during the Nitrogg Thundertower, and the defeating the boss himself in Grimrail Depot on Heroic difficulty. Knockback abilities/spells are required to throw the mobs from the train. These include Thunderstorm, Typhoon, Explosive Trap using the modified glyph, and Siegebreaker.
Nina Dingzap is a goblin found on an island with Brix Rocketcast in Warspear in Ashran.
Noble's Eternal Elementium Signet is sold by Haris Pilton in Shattrath City for .

Niskara is a prison world under the control of the Burning Legion. It was one of the many planets the draenei stopped on during their attempts to escape the Legion; the race only managing to escape thanks to the sacrifice of a few vindicators that remained behind with the staff, T'uure, Beacon of the Naaru. The Legion ship docked here is referred to as "the Cathedral" and a group of inquisitors called "the Inquisition" have a presence here. Alleria Windrunner and Locus-Walker were held and tortured here.

Nithogg is a storm drake world boss located atop Nastrondir in Stormheim while Scourge of the Skies is available. He used to be a servant to the keepers, but broke free. Vethir wanted him dead for terrorizing the lands of Stormheim. He also appears during Dances With Ravenbears. Chief Cukkaw and his tribe of wildkin attempt to gain the titanic storm drake's favor with a jolly dance ritual. Nithogg, apparently unimpressed, incinerates the entire tribe with a single breath before flying off.
No Shellfish Endeavor is an achievement earned from completing the listed Murky quests in Highmountain, Stormheim and Suramar.

No'ci the Scribe is a Zandalari troll located at the Zocalo in Dazar'alor. When the traitorous prophet Zul and Mythrax attacked the city, No'ci was cornered by the invading sethrak. She was rescued by the Speaker of the Horde and joined the fight alongside Princess Talanji.
No Turning Back took place at the Shatterspear War Camp during the War of the Thorns.
Niru Datagear is a Mechagon mechagnome located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island. She is also encountered in Operation: Mechagon.
Nobu is an ankoan flight master located at the Tidal Conflux in Nazjatar.
The Niskaran Morning Star drops from the following demons in the Legion Assaults: *Fel Commander Erixtol *Lord Commander Alexius *Dread Vizier Gra'tork *Xeritas
No Tourist is an expansion feature achievement earned by winning 10 Island Expeditions on Normal difficulty or higher.

Niya is a sylvar protector of Heartwood Grove located in Ardenweald and a major character in the Ardenweald storyline. She is good friends with Korenth, Wagonmaster Derawyn, Te'zan, and eventually Ara'lon. Initially facing severe tragedy, she eventually finds the strength to help save Ardenweald from the Drust invasion.

Niya, As Xavius is a exploration achievement that doesn't appear to be available. Instead, there's a single achievement for participating in all of the performances at the Star Lake Amphitheater: Ardenweald's a Stage.

Nilganihmaht's Gold Band is found at on the mountaintop overlooking Calcis on the southwestern part of the Maw mainland. This is one of five rings required to acquire the Nilganihmaht Control Ring, a crawling hand mount. Nirazal is a dracthyr flight master located at the Vault of the Incarnates in Thaldraszus.
Nirathan is a dracthyr located in the Canals in Stormwind City. He can be found walking between the Trade District and Old Town, looking at a map.
Niuzao's Fortitude is a pet ability available exclusively to the Oxen family of hunter pets.

In World of Warcraft, normal means a couple of things: #A player's default condition. When a character spends time at an inn or in a city, the character's condition changes to rested. When the player uses up all of the bonus "bubbles" acquired while resting, the player's condition changes back to normal. When in normal condition, the player's experience bar will be colored purple.See also Rest. #A type of realm also called PvE. #Dungeon difficulty, there are two settings for post-TBC dungeons, normal and heroic.

North Tide's Hollow was a region of Silverpine Forest just north of the Sepulcher. The Hollow was one of the many haunts of the evil Moonrage worgen, the servants of the Archmage Arugal. These worgen set up very crude encampments in some places. These camps employed only the meanest necessities of survival needed by the tough worgen. While the subzone has been removed, the camp still exists, but as part of the North Tide's Beachhead.

__NOTOC__ Noggrin Onetooth was a unique kobold to the north of Orgrimmar during the Founding of Durotar. He was killed by Rexxar and Rokhan in To Tame a Land. Rexxar looted a magical Hood of Cunning off of the kobold's corpse.

Northeron was a region and the northernmost part of the Twilight Highlands. It was known for its mysterious ironwood tree forests, the torrential storms from its frozen mountains, ominous and foreboding peaks, and jagged ice cliffs. Some of the Wildhammer gryphon riders who fought in the Second War hailed from this place, including Kurdran Wildhammer.

The region of referred to as Northern Kalimdor or North Kalimdor, is the northernmost region or continent of Kalimdor, north of central Kalimdor. Several years have passed since the Alliance and Horde arrived on Kalimdor, and the night elves have done their best to adapt to the presence of these newcomers. While the Horde initially fought against the night elves, at great cost to both sides, eventually all three groups were willing to cooperate when faced with the Burning Legion. Since then, the night elves joined the Alliance, and hostilities have broken out against the Horde once again. The Horde now inhabits much of central Kalimdor, and northern borderlands like Ashenvale and Azshara hav

Northdale is a destroyed town located north of Light's Hope Chapel and southeast of the entrance to Quel'Thalas in the Eastern Plaguelands. It is where Taelan Fordring renounced the Order of the Silver Hand and joined the Scarlet Crusade. The ruins are inhabited by banshees and invisible eyeless watchers, while the nearby lake is populated by corrupted water elementals.

The North Coast is a stretch of beach bordering a portion of the Great Sea. It lies along the northern edge of the Tirisfal Glades, and is mostly inhabited by ravenous murlocs and various marine animals. Since the Plague of Undeath marred the region with its taint, the coast has become dark and cold, the site of several dead sea creatures rotting at the edge of the water. The murloc Deeb can be found standing idle here. In the Battle for Lordaeron, the coast became the landing site for the Alliance, destroying much of it — including the murloc huts. The trail of destruction ranging from the Alliance's landfall to the ruins of Brill is called the Lion's Wake.
Normalization refers to an Attack Power adjustment made to instant attacks in patch 1.8. Hunter ranged instant attacks were also normalized in patch 1.10.

A node is a point of interaction. Specifically, a node may refer to a vertex on a graph, like a destination on a flight path map. A node can also refer to a resource node, such as the five found in Arathi Basin. Resource nodes may also refer to the place where herbs, mining nodes, fishing pools or gas clouds spawn, or to the herbs, mining nodes, pools or clouds themselves. Cobalt Deposits were known as Cobalt Nodes during the Wrath of the Lich King beta. Generally, a node can be any point at which entities spawn, like graveyards or starting locations in battlegrounds.

.]] The North Sea is the name of the sea west and north of Quel'Thalas, and north and east of Northrend. The Isle of Quel'Danas, off the northern coast of the Eversong Woods, and other smaller islands near Northrend are located in this sea. As per Exile's Reach location, the North Sea also extends from southeastern Northrend to northwestern Lordaeron.
Noosegrip Gauntlets are a quest reward from Deep Ocean, Vast Sea.

Nolkai is likely to have been one of the night elf citizens of Loreth'Aran in Bloodmyst Isle. Although Nolkai is not explicitly identified as a night elf, evidence such as a reference to Elune on his ring, and the geographic location of his old home, tend to lend that interpretation. He was witness to an invasion or attack upon his homeland, which would likely have been the black dragonflight's attack on Loreth'Aran. At one stage during this attack, he and a number of other survivors retreated east into a temple. In an attempt to preserve the memory of what happened, Nolkai buried all that remained of his possessions near the temple in a box. The ruins of this temple now form what little rem

Nori Blackfinger was once a Master Weaponsmith living in the Searing Gorge, specifically at Thorium Point. His blades were some of the finest in the world, and adventurers far and wide traveled to Thorium Point to have a weapon made by him. His skills created weapons that became known to be unbreakable, and wielding a weapon forged by Nori "almost assured victory." Nori, however, grew greedy. He left Thorium Point and traveled to the port city of Booty Bay, where he earned a month's pay in the Gorge twice in one fortnight and opened a shop called Black Finger. After his business proved successful and the town began to like him, he sent for his son, Eli. Nori would continue his business with

Nordu is an Ancient of Lore located in the Flamewake on Mount Hyjal. Ysera calls Nordu the oldest of the trees. He has stood in the center of what is now The Flamewake for thousands of years. His wisdom is as old as the mountain itself. He has been burned down to the core and will not last much longer, but before he dies he wishes to pass on his wisdom. He died prior to the events of the Firelands Invasion, and the hill he stood on was named after him in his memory.

The Northern Rocketway Terminus is a station of the Bilgewater Cartel Rocketway, located directly north of Bilgewater Harbor and southwest of Sable Ridge. Like the southern terminus, it has a flight master, located on the platform near the Bilgewater Rocket-jockey. The Rocket-jockey will greet successful arrivals with, "Welcome to the Northern Rocketway Terminus! You probably took a wrong turn, but we're happy to have you anyway!" In addition to the lack of NPCs, this part of the rocketway is not classified as its own subzone, instead being classified as part of the Bitter Reaches.

Northern Barrens is a zone for Horde players. Since the Cataclysm, the zone has been thrown into disarray with floods, earthquakes and a Quilboar invasion. Players travel around the zone trying to create stability and preserve the connection between Orgrimmar and Thunder Bluff. The progress of the storyline is tracked in the achievement Northern Barrens Quests.
Nocturnal Strike is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Nordrassil Wisps are magic critters that live in the Mount Hyjal.
__NOTOC__ Nomaeaa is a draenei flight master located at Redemption Rise in Talador.
Nom is a corgi being chased by Tof around a small, hidden camp at the waterfalls northeast of Stormwind City. The two of them are the pets of Turp and Roo, who can be found standing nearby.
__NOTOC__ Noressa is Absolon's wife. She can be found at the The Grand Promenade in the city of Suramar and later in Shal'Aran.
Norgabbon of Stonedark is a drogbar located in Highmountain during the Legion Assaults.
Northern Icelips are fished from the Hyper-Compressed Ocean.
Norbit Control Pannel is located on Mechagon Island. It activates Norbit Z-12.
Nomi's Vintage is a quest reward from Sip and Savor. When used, it briefly launches the player into the air in a steep arc with a trail of fire behind them.
Nomi's Wine is looted from the Nightborne Vat in Suramar City.
Noden Gyrozap is a Mechagon mechagnome located at Rustbolt on Mechagon Island.

Northpass Tower is a scout tower located in the Eastern Plaguelands. It is, as the name implies, the farthest north of the towers, lying along the road to the Ghostlands in Quel'Thalas. During the Scourge invasion of Lordaeron, Northpass Tower was destroyed and left in ruins. Later it became a battleground as it was one of the fallen towers that the Alliance and Horde fought over for in order to fortify themselves in Lordaeron. Northpass Tower, along with all the other towers of the Eastern Plaguelands, have since been rebuilt by the Argent Crusade and is being used as an outpost for the region. Like the nearby Light's Hope Chapel, there are signs of life around the tower, and there is also

In the Netherstorm at the edge of the Crumbling Waste, south of Arklon Ruins and west of Manaforge Coruu, is a small blue shrine only reachable by flying mount. The shrine is a futuristic-looking draenei tombstone surrounded by pink crystals. On the tomb flashes the letters N, O, V, and A, spelling out the name of the playable character from the discontinued Blizzard game StarCraft: Ghost. Under certain conditions, you can see her ghost kneeling at the monument. If you listen closely, you can hear "StarCraft" music playing by the monument.

Below are listed a few Horde-favoring areas and quests you may wish to visit and complete while leveling for the reason of simplicity and swift ascension in levels. This article is not intended as a leveling guide, a Places to Farm list, or a list of specific zones designated for an eternal grind. Basically, If you ever thought something along the lines of "man, if only I had known beforehand that such a large number of quests were implemented into this zone to be completed simultaneously and with little effort," we encourage you expand this list with your findings.

Northrend Vanguard is a Reputation achievement for gaining reputation with the four neutral factions in Northrend. The Feat of Strength version, Realm First! Northrend Vanguard is awarded to the first player on any given realm to accomplish this achievement.
Northrend Explorer is a meta exploration achievement earned for exploring all the zones in the continent of the Northrend. Required for the meta-achievement Universal Explorer.
A sortable table for all daily quests on the Northrend continent.
Not So Fast is a player vs. player achievement earned for killing a player who is under the effects of a speed power-up in the Warsong Gulch battleground.

The Northwatch Expedition Base Camp (or just the Northwatch Expedition Base) is an Alliance camp located near the Unearthed Grounds, headed by Force Commander Valen in the Stonetalon Mountains. Accessible from the Greatwood Vale, it overlooks Grimtotem Post and the conflict taking place there. It is from here that the Alliance began digging what is now known as the Deep Reaches, and the outpost also opens up to the Unearthed Grounds; both areas are the site of conflict with the Horde at present. Due to the ongoing war effort, contingents of Northwatch Infantry regularly pass through here. Members of the Explorers' League are also present due to the excavations. At some point, when the Allian

grunt.]] The Northwatch Expeditionary Unit is a group of sailors and soldiers sent from Northwatch Hold and Theramore to attempt to gain a further stronghold into Kalimdor. They've been spotted in Durotar, the Barrens, Azshara and the Stonetalon Mountains. They are recognizable by their Theramore Tabards.

Northgate River is a river found on the Gilnean peninsula. It runs from a waterfall coming down the eastern section of the Greymane Wall, crossing the Northgate Woods and past Emberstone Village, around Gilneas City, to at least Aderic's Repose, and empties into the sea through a narrow area between the two headlands. The Undertaker's Pass runs under it, connecting Greymane Court to Aderic's Repose.

The Northgate Woods is a forested area in Gilneas, located north of Gilneas City and south of the Greymane Wall. The Northgate River acts as its eastern border while the road leading to the wall's entrance is its western border. There is no incentive to go here during the worgen starting experience. By the time of the Silverpine Forest storyline, the area is not a displayed subzone. The Forsaken Forward Command and Rutsak's Guard are located here.
Northwatch Captain Kosak is a level 29 elite human located in Windshear Hold, Stonetalon Mountains. He is currently recovering from an attack by a spider queen. He also goes by the nickname "Koko".

Northwatch Guards are standard footmen and guard NPCs who can be found at Northwatch Hold, Teegan's Expedition, and Forward Command in the Southern Barrens, as well as Northwatch Expedition Base Camp in Stonetalon Mountains. One of the soldiers stationed at Forward Command will regularly make small talk about things like someone's weapon needing cleaning. He will also lead the in a drill.

Northwatch Riflemen are human troops from Northwatch Hold who can be found at Forward Command in the Southern Barrens. One of the s will regularly instruct one group of riflemen in a drill and they will practice shooting, though no actual action takes place. They are named Holmberg, Grizwald, Jackson, and Barkley. One tried Sam Trawley's Big Haunch of Stormsnout Meat but was zapped by a bolt of electricity.

Northwatch Infantries are the footmen of Northwatch Hold who are stationed in and around Northwatch Expedition Base Camp in Stonetalon Mountains, where they can be seen marching in rather large groups as well as standing at attention in front of .
Nourishing Waters is a breadcrumb quest leading you back to the now completed Moonwell at Malfurion's Breach.

Northwatch Lugs are humans and dwarves found at Northwatch Foothold in Durotar. They carry Northwatch Supply Crates from their camp in Darkspear Strand into Northwatch Foothold. They will not attack until they, the Northwatch Supply Crate they are carrying, or any being carried nearby is attacked. Although they usually attack in groups, they are extremely weak. If they are carrying a crate directly over their head, destroying the crate will cause them to die (as the crate falls on them).
Northshear Abbey is a barbershop located in the Trade District of Stormwind City. It is named after the nearby Northshire Abbey. Genevieve is the owner of the salon.

Norushen is a titanic watcher who watched over and guarded the Heart of the Old God Y'Shaarj beneath the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. When the containment around the Heart of Y'Shaarj was breached, Norushen assisted adventurers by generating buffs for them to use. Following the Heart's capture by Garrosh Hellscream and the corruption of the Vale, Norushen challenged the adventurers to purify their corruption, Pride, before bringing them to face the Sha of Pride further down the titan containment chamber. In the ensuing battle with the Sha, Norushen was slain by the creature, but used the last of his strength to reduce the corruption of all present adventurers. Some say that the mogu race was cr

Not For You is an achievement earned by defeating the Tichondrius encounter in the Nighthold instance without taking damage from his Echoes of the Void ability, on Normal difficulty or higher. Before casting Echoes of the Void, Tichondrius will spawn numerous pillars around the room. Standing behind these pillars will negate all damage from Echoes of the Void. Thus, to obtain the achievement, get behind these pillars every time Echoes of the Void is cast before it deals any damage, and then defeat the boss.
Note for Old Mefu is a memorial note dedicated to Old Nefu found at a shrine in the Snowblind Mesa in Highmountain.
Note for Oro is a memorial note dedicated to Warbrave Oro found at a shrine in the Snowblind Mesa in Highmountain.
Note for Oakin is a memorial note dedicated to Oakin Ironbull found at a shrine in the Snowblind Mesa in Highmountain.
Northwatch Encroachers are humans and dwarves located in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Northwatch Expedition Base Camp Inn is an inn located in the Northwatch Expedition Base Camp in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Northrend Mystery Gem Pouches are sold by Lhara during Darkmoon Faire for .
Nose For Trouble is a passive racial ability for vulpera, reducing the first damage taken from enemies by 5% of maximum health.
Notorious is an expansion features achievement earned by winning 50 Island Expeditions in PvP.

Notorious Gladiator: Battle for Azeroth Season 3 is a feat of strength achievement earned by ending Battle for Azeroth PvP Season 3 in the top 0.1% of the 3v3 arena ladder (requiring 150 games won on your current faction).

Notorious Gladiator's Proto-Drake is an achievement reward from Gladiator: Battle for Azeroth Season 3. Obtaining this mount also awards the Feat of Strength Notorious Gladiator's Proto-Drake (achievement).
Northrend Adventurers are traveling to Northrend by using the Dalaran portal found in Pathfinder's Den of Orgrimmar and Wizard's Sanctum of Stormwind City. <!--
Not-Scratchy Faceguard is a quest reward from Primal Reagents of Power.
Northwatch Gryphon is a gryphon used during Repel Boarders! to fly the Alliance adventurer from Northwatch Hold in the Southern Barrens to the Blackpool and vice-versa.
Notes on Dragonkin Equality is provided by Investigator Erima to show it to the Flightless rebels at Rebellious Cliffs for Wreckonciliation.

OP is used sometimes in forum posts, and is short for original post or original poster. It refers to the post that initiated the thread or the person who wrote it. In game chat, OP almost exclusively stands for overpowered.

Nyse was formerly a wind rider flight master located in Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. She is now present at Mudsprocket requesting aid and to send Horde adventurers to Thousand Needles. Oddly, it seems that she and Thyssiana have mistaken Brogg to be the leader of Mudsprocket, even though he and Axle have a conversation right in front of them that clearly states he isn't.

__NOTOC__ Nozari is a dragon of the bronze dragonflight. She can be found in both adult and child elven forms, at the same time, in the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. She is the sister of Andormu, whom she stands next to (in both forms), and also co-leader of Keepers of Time.
The Oathstone of Ysera's Dragonflight is given to the player at the conclusion of a conversation with Itharius about Eranikus. Using this item begins the quest The Essence of Eranikus (2).

The Noxious is located inside Maraudon, and is situated near the end of Foulspore Cavern. It is the most physically corrupt part of the dungeon, and is full of belching fungi, crawling maggots, twisted lashers, as well as the very source of the toxicity - the poison elemental Noxxion.

"O Thanagor" (lit. "O King") is a song first introduced during the Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne closing cinematic. The song became a recurring lyrical leitmotif in World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King, appearing in several songs, including "Arthas, My Son" and "Invincible." The song also appears as part of the medley in the World of Warcraft: Cataclysm main theme, "The Shattering."

The Oasis of Vir'sar is an oasis located in the northwestern corner of Uldum, right by the Obelisk of the Moon. Harrison Jones and some other people traveled here with a caravan and built a small camp in the northwestern section of the oasis where adventurers are sent here by Jones himself after saving them from Commander Schnottz. The oasis is home to many crocolisks. During the events of the Black Empire Campaign, the Wastewanders were present in the oasis.
Oathsworn Axemasters are tol'vir located in the Lost City of the Tol'vir.
__NOTOC__ Oathsworn Captain are tol'vir found in the Lost City of the Tol'vir.

__NOTOC__ Nymn is blue dragon in the guise of a high elf in Everlook. He sends adventurers to report to his mother, Haleh, during the quest 'The Pursuit of Umbranse'. It's possible that he went to Everlook to oversee the mortals' actions near the Blue Dragonflight territory.
__NOTOC__ Oasis Moths are critters found in Uldum and Lost City of the Tol'vir.
Nut Barrage is an ability used by squirrels and chipmunks during a Pet Battle.

Nysis was a saurok defender at the Serpent's Spine, under the reign of the mogu. He and his fellows did battle with a young Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver, before he was a paragon, in his first brush with hand-to-hand combat. Nysis was incredulous that a mantid flyer would do battle on the ground, but attacked anyway after a moment's hesitation. Kil'ruk blocked the saurok's blade with his own, and then dealt him a mortal blow with a second sword he'd taken from another fallen saurok. As he lay dying in the mud, Nysis' last thoughts were still shock at his opponent's presence on the field.

Nythendra is the first boss of the Emerald Nightmare. Once a green dragon, Nythendra is now a living corpse, animated by the insects and corruptive powers of the nightmare. The battle revolves around the "Rot" debuff and keeping it from overwhelming the raid. While a simple encounter on normal difficulty, the fight becomes an unforgiving raid environment on heroic and mythic, with the Infest debuff able to gradually whittle players down and putting a massive strain on healers.

Nulil is a blood elf or dwarf (depending on the race of the player) priest that is a part of the Uber Town group. He can be briefly seen during the flashback of the confrontation with Illidan Stormrage atop the Black Temple.
Now You're Thinking With Portals is a quest achievement awarded upon activating all the teleporters in Suramar.

.]] .]] Ny'alotha, the Waking City is the final raid instance of Battle for Azeroth. It was introduced in patch 8.3.0 on January 14, 2020. with Battle for Azeroth Season 4. The raid entrance is located in a large floating obelisk located above either Whitepetal Lake in Vale of Eternal Blossoms or Vir'naal Dam in Uldum, depending on which zone is currently under assault from the Black Empire.
The Ny'alotha Allseer drops from N'Zoth the Corruptor in Ny'alotha, the Waking City on mythic difficulty.
Oath of Druids is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Nyx is a spectral tiger found sleeping next to Matthien Radiantgaze in the Tipsy Tinkerer in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island.
Nuzoriak the Experimenter is a dragonman located in Island Expeditions.
Nuru Emberbraid is a yaungol located on Molten Cay during Island Expeditions.
